message.content:
Based on the screenshot:

**Yes, there is a notification popup visible** in the **bottom-right corner** of the screen. It says:
- **"Message Sent Successfully"**
- Below that: *"Thank you for reaching out to Emrais Engineering Services. We will respond within 24 hours."*

**Regarding the contact form:** The form appears to be **empty/reset** (or the fields are showing placeholder text):
- The "Subject" field shows placeholder text: *"Project Inquiry"*
- The "Message" field shows placeholder text: *"Tell us about your project..."*
- No user-entered data is visible in the input fields

This suggests that after the form was submitted, it was either cleared automatically or reset, and the success notification appeared to confirm the message was sent.
